app.name: Augusta Golf - Range v0.6
app.long_description: Driving-range vertical slice for the Augusta Golf homebrew project. Fine terrain mesh, perspective fog, targets, trees, visible golfer and live Wiimote-driven club motion. Hold B and move the Wii Remote to preview the swing; release B to strike. D-pad left/right aims, up/down changes club, + resets, HOME exits.
